items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser that keeps skin clean without stripping it.
A fragrance-free hydrating serum to help skin look fresher and more plump, since moisture scored a little low.
A light ceramide moisturizer that supports the skin barrier without feeling heavy on oily skin.
A mineral SPF 50 for daily protection, which helps skin look brighter and more even over time.

response.routine_note: I left out the 30% peel because strong acid peels are best avoided during pregnancy, so please check with your doctor or midwife before adding any exfoliating acids. Use the cleanser, serum and moisturizer morning and night, and finish with the SPF each morning.
